scope: Generic five-stage biosignal spectrogram/sequence classification; independent binary dual-branch realization planned.
implemented: Per-recording fixed windows, explicit stride and omitted trailing-sample count
Segment-mean detrending, periodic Hann, one-sided density-normalized PSD and log1p
1D waveform CNN and 2D spectrogram CNN with frequency-preserving temporal pooling
Seeded bounded time/frequency masking with input immutability
checks: Explicit odd/even DFT and Parseval density checks
Both neural branch gradients and batch independence
Mask bounds, repeatability and zero-mask identity
pending: Subject-disjoint state boundary with explicit sample rate and channel count
Training-only normalization and augmented weighted training
Recording aggregation and held-out threshold lifecycle
limitations: Synthetic signals only; no clinical or historical accuracy claim
Incomplete windows and FFT segments are omitted explicitly
No shared state or statistics fitted across populations
